title: Selected Work
subtitle: AI shipped into production, the research behind it, and the judgment calls that kept it safe to ship

bio.short: I've led design for fifteen years. The last one went into building AI that ships rather than demos. At Bibel TV that means a customer-support copilot live in production, and a fundraising system I built end to end. Before that: design leadership at Ninox and ChurchDesk, and five years at Datameer designing for banks and insurers, where being wrong was expensive.
bio.long:
The work I'd look at first is the support copilot at Bibel TV. It drafts replies to viewer letters from the support handbook. Most of the design was deciding what it must not do. Restricted topics are enforced. The send decision never leaves a human. It went out fully optional, so people use it because it earns its place.

The fundraising system is the one I built alone. Analysis of what separated letters that worked from letters that didn't, then the prompt architecture, then the prototype, then the production skill that generates follow-up content for in-app, web and video. At Ninox I designed the prompt-to-database onboarding with the CEO and technical co-founder. The generated schema renders into the real data-model editor rather than a chat preview, so people can see and correct what the model produced. It became the basis for the public AI beta.

What connects that work to tax filing is the stakes. At Datameer the users were analysts inside banks and insurers, and I ran research inside institutions that make user access genuinely hard. At ChurchDesk I shipped AI into production under GDPR plus church data-protection law across six countries. Reframing one client's booking request into a platform capability produced a 70% cut in coordination time and 90% acceptance at the launch customer, where funerals had to be bookable across 20+ cemeteries. It then shipped to every customer as a general booking capability. Consequential products are where I've spent most of my time.

context.company: Taxfix Group — consumer tax filing across Germany, Spain and the UK, over 400 professionals. Moving from pure self-filing to an assisted service that connects people to human tax advisors.
context.role: Product Design Director, AI Tax Filing. Leadership, not IC. Manages senior Product Designers, UX Researchers and Content Designers, with performance ownership, reporting into product leadership.
context.emphasis: Lead with AI shipped into production and the research practice underneath it — Claude over thousands of forum posts at Ninox, feedback and ticket mining at ChurchDesk, interview transcription and analysis at Bibel TV, and the threshold that governs when AI analysis is used at all. Then the judgment calls that made the AI safe to ship: manual operation so a person reads every message first, the send decision staying human, quality agreed with users before the prompt was tuned.
